text:
Alex: Quick PR opened to clarify air-gapped installer egress for Azure Gov/private endpoints and fallback behavior for KMS when HSM is unreachable. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/3124

Maria: @Alex good timing. Can you add an nftables + systemd snippet and call out the PKCS#11 socket/path for vendor HSMs?

Alex: Added initial snippets in the branch — main points: - show outbound egress to telemetry/metrics endpoints via NAT or proxy - include KMS proxy env var example (REDWOOD_KMS_PROXY) - call out common PKCS#11 path examples (e.g., /usr/lib/opensc-pkcs11.so or /opt/hsm/lib/pkcs11.so)

Sam: Can you paste the nftables snippet here? easier to eyeball than jumping to the PR.

Alex: ```nft
table inet redwood-egress {
  chain output {
    type filter hook output priority 0;
    ip daddr {198.51.100.0/24, 203.0.113.5} counter accept # telemetry + metrics
    tcp dport {443, 8041} ct state established,related accept
    counter reject with icmpx admin-prohibited
  }
}
```
Also adding a systemd drop-in example to ensure the installer has the proxy env: ```ini
[Service]
Environment="REDWOOD_KMS_PROXY=http://10.0.0.5:3128"
```

Julie: Tiny nit: in the "Private networking" section the flag name changed in installer v0.9.4 — `--allow-private-endpoints` -> `--enable-private-dns`. Can you reflect that and add a short migration note?

Ben: Also call out offline bundle size: some customers include vendor HSM libs in the airgap tar and hit the 500MB CDN/upload limit. Maybe recommend mounting vendor libs from a package mirror instead of bundling.

Maria: :thumbsup: I'll do a quick proofread + link check. Sam, can you run a smoke install on an Azure Gov subscription once Alex updates the migration note?

Sam: On it. I can test tomorrow morning. Ping infra for a test subscription or I can use the corp lab.

deploy-bot: preview site built: https://deploy-preview.redwood.io/3124 — includes the new snippets and migration note.

Alex: Thanks — added explicit restart note: existing installs must restart `redwood-installer.service` after adding vendor PKCS#11 packages. Example command: `sudo systemctl restart redwood-installer`

Julie: LGTM after Maria's edits and Ben's bundle note. If Sam's smoke test is green, let's merge.

Maria: Edits done, fixed a broken link (docs/kms/proxy -> docs/kms/proxy-config) and updated the flag name. Ready for merge from my side.

Sam: Smoke test passed: installer boots in Azure Gov, HSM PKCS#11 loads, KMS proxy fallback works, and egress is locked down. No unexpected firewall openings. :shipit:

Alex: :tada: merging now. Thanks everyone for the quick turn-around.
